title: Three People Sitting in Park, 1955 Vintage Snapshot B&W Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from August 1955 featuring three people (a man and two women) sitting together on a low stone wall or bench in an outdoor park setting surrounded by lush greenery. The photo features deckled edges and a date stamp reading 'AUG • 55' at the top border. The image is slightly out of focus, capturing mid-20th-century casual summer attire.
